data.name: Family Hike to a Hidden Lake & Swim
data.description: A guided hike for families and anyone seeking a unique adventure. We’ll take you off the beaten path to secluded Polly Dome Lake for swimming and a picnic. This lake is so hidden, it’s not on any trails! Explore a side of Yosemite that few tourists ever see.

meeting_point.address: Murphy Creek Trailhead, TUOLUMNE MEADOWS, CA US

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never canceled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
**Packing List:**
• Sun Hat
• Sunglasses
• Water Bottle (1L per person)
• Sunscreen
• Bug spray
• Swimsuit
• Small Towel
• Raincoat & Warm Layer

**Optional:**
• Sandals, *to wear at the lake, not for hiking*
• Child Life Jacket
• Cash, to tip your guide!

*We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, snacks and lunch!*
